function.name: rectangle_area
function.description: Calculate the area of a rectangle with given length and width Unlike circle_area, which calculates the area of a circle, this calculates the area of a rectangle.

function.name: circle_area
function.description: Calculate the area of a circle with given radius Unlike rectangle_area, which calculates the area of a rectangle, this calculates the area of a circle.

radius.description: Radius of the circle This is a float type value.

isDiameter.description: Whether the given length is the diameter of the circle.

function.name: triangle_area

base.description: Base of the triangle This is a float type value.
